trap.label: bring × take
trap.wrong: I will bring you to the airport tomorrow.
trap.right: I will take you to the airport tomorrow.
trap.why: Em português “levar” cobre os dois movimentos. Em inglês, bring vai em direção a quem fala; take, para longe.

fix.wrong: He brought up the cost, but nobody takes it up.
fix.right: He brought up the cost, but nobody took it up.

fix.wrong: They bring forward the date yesterday.
fix.right: They brought forward the date yesterday.

fix.wrong: It brought to light the problem.
fix.right: It brought the problem to light.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com brought up: “He mentioned the cost.”
Reescreva com bring about: “Reform caused change.”
Reescreva com bring forward: “We moved the date earlier.”
